limitations.message: The packet excludes one file, so conclusions cover only the supplied excerpts.
No authoritative Python lockfile is supplied.
Environment and pytest plugin behavior cannot be assessed from the supplied declarations.
This assessment uses static evidence only.
No per-test timing history is supplied.

rows.rationale: The supplied tests call pure functions with literal inputs and assert a concrete sum and rejection of a negative age. These cases need no record factory.
The visible test bodies use immutable literals, but fixture lifetime and any implicit fixture state are not established by the packet.
The supplied tests contain direct function calls. Database, server, and schema setup scope and cost are not established.
Resource isolation is undeclared, and the packet does not establish database naming, ownership, or cleanup boundaries.
The resource declaration does not establish cache use, key ownership, or deletion boundaries.
The packet does not establish writable file allocation, listening port allocation, or resource release behavior.
Probe isolation is explicitly undeclared. No network denial or isolated fake boundary is established.
The runner declares a cooperative process group lifecycle, but spawn, cancellation, joining, and reaping behavior are not supplied.
The supplied cases perform synchronous integer arithmetic and string conversion with literal inputs. Their behavior is deterministic and independent of clocks or synchronization.
Test selection is explicitly disabled, so closed input mappings and selection fallback policy do not apply to this configuration.
No per-test timing measurements or history are supplied, so duration and integration cost cannot be assessed.
